threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a bus is quicker than a bike here. That’s cute, hon, but the Hackney bike life has its own rhythm.
Caught the N35 last night, and a guy was playing the sax. Everyone clapped when he hit those high notes. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the kebab shop owner arguing with the delivery guy about missing hot sauce, and both were laughing by the end. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a café with a giant trampoline in the backyard, while the owner debates philosophy with patrons over organic coffee.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to avoid BART during rush hour after a breakdown—everyone else just stands there confused, wondering what the loud bang was.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the 38 bus with a ukulele while waiting for the 47. Only in SF does a bus stop become a stage.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the park guell statues are the main attraction, but the real magic is the quiet streets of the neighborhood after sunset.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still hesitate at crosswalks, waiting for the 'green man' despite the cars having stopped.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can always spot a newbie by how they still wait for the Tube during strike days, while the locals calmly grab a bike or walk it.
Caught a night bus from Canada Water the other week; an old chap tried to sell me an ancient map of London. Said it was 'the real treasure' but forgot where he got it from.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a toddler waving at a pigeon outside my window, while two artists painted a mural on the building next door. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a bustling market on a Tuesday morning selling everything from vegan cheeses to vintage vinyl. It’s a hidden gem for locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re a local when they still call it 'Civic Center' and not 'Twitter headquarters' during the BART chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that had a band onboard, playing to the aisle. If that’s not San Francisco, I don’t know what is. Everyone was vibing.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just the hipster hub. They miss the real heart in its quiet squares where locals gossip over coffee.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them lingering at the metro machine, puzzled by the ticket options, while locals zip by with their preloaded T-cards.
